name: Card
description: A bordered container that groups related content under an optional heading, with an optional footer for actions.

title.description: Heading shown at the top. Also names the card for screen readers.

footer.description: Actions or meta information along the bottom, e.g. buttons.

headingLevel.description: Heading level for the title, 2 to 6. Pick the level that fits where the card sits in the page's outline.

variant.description: outlined has a border, raised adds a shadow, subtle is a tinted block with no border.

requirements: With a title, the card is a group labelled by it; without one it is a plain container
The title is a real heading at the level you choose, so the page outline stays correct
A card is not a landmark and not focusable: put links and buttons inside it
screenReader: Entering a titled card announces its name and that it is a group
The title is reachable as a heading when navigating by headings

use_when: Grouping a small set of related facts or controls, like a plan, a project or a setting
avoid_when: Rows of the same record type: use a table or data grid
anti_patterns: A heading level that skips (h1 then h4)
Making the whole card clickable and also putting buttons in it
